title: ex04-preparedstatement-binding
expected_output:
已绑定占位符数: 3
绑定后SQL: INSERT INTO t_user(user_name, age, email) VALUES('alice', 30, 'a@x.com')
顺序一致? True
code:
def bind(sql, params):
    out = []
    i = 0
    for ch in sql:
        if ch == "?":
            out.append(repr(params[i])); i += 1
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out), i

sql = "INSERT INTO t_user(user_name, age, email) VALUES(?, ?, ?)"
params = ["alice", 30, "a@x.com"]
bound, n = bind(sql, params)
print("已绑定占位符数:", n)
print("绑定后SQL:", bound)
print("顺序一致?", n == len(params))
